main_text.p: feruet, & ab omnibus maleuolo-rum iniurijs vindicet, atque tuea-tur. Valete. Scriptum Neo-comi, Kalend. Sextili-bus, 1579.

page.notes: The first line of the page is a continuation of the previous page's paragraph. Line-end hyphens are printed and kept. The word "iniurijs" is printed with j and kept as printed. The number "1579" is printed with a raised final figure and is copied as 1579. A stray mark at the top left and show-through from the other side of the leaf are not transcribed.
